pdf_details.title: A visible front returns above the rack
pdf_details.note: The fifth pale front has its own visible seam and ends above the rack. The r6 deletion was too broad. It returns as CURRENT56, after BASE55, with the hidden left corner missing. Other right points move off the rail.

pdf_details.title: Keep the front, exclude the rack
pdf_details.note: BASE56/57 become CURRENT57/58 after the addition. Their boxes retain their own raised rims and stop above the rack; the visible lower-front turns are corrected independently.

pdf_details.title: A rail intersection is not a corner
pdf_details.note: BASE58/59 become CURRENT59/60. Front material remains labeled. The inherited inset left point on BASE58 cannot reliably locate the physical corner; both fronts keep missing endpoints where the rail or gripper prevents a reliable location.

pdf_details.title: Trim the box without clipping a landmark
pdf_details.note: The source supports removing left rack and lower background. The rough blue bottom would exclude the existing left point; this conservative box retains both landmarks. This development edit never changes the frozen answer keys.

pdf_details.title: Correct one corner; keep uncertainty visible
pdf_details.note: The left point moves to the upper front wall turn near(558,546). The box and lower pale fragments still have unresolved ownership. No extra cassette is inferred solely from the suggested rectangles.

pdf_details.title: A tapered projection needs physical identification
pdf_details.note: BASE27 bottom moves513 to509 to exclude exposed rack. BASE24-26 remain held: their gray projections descend below the proposed main-face bottoms, so trimming them would assume those surfaces are excluded sides or lips.

pdf_details.title: Lower-front corners, not the strip below
pdf_details.note: Boxes follow each observed front. BASE10-13 left points move up to the actual lower-front turns. Existing right-point corrections and both BASE14 points remain unchanged; there is no universal inset rule.

pdf_details.title: Separate a clear trim from a held top
pdf_details.note: Right1033 to1030 and bottom468 to466 remove rack/shadow margins. The top near412 remains held against the proposed419-420 edge. Both points stay unchanged.

pdf_details.title: Restore the user-confirmed cyan box
pdf_details.note: Copy the exact original box tokens: its top returns from about15 to47.56 pixels. The bottom and all points are unchanged. The full eight-row review file now matches the original file byte for byte; broader old-series holds are not silently cleared.
